svg.title: Decasia / six material patterns, thirty-six parameter studies
svg.desc: Six rows, one per reference cut. Each row starts with a baseline and changes exactly one control in each of five subsequent columns. All cells use the same source, seed and sampled time. Polarity, fragment displacement and stretch are labeled artistic extensions. Native C++ output.
